 The national average for a gallon of regular unleaded is now $3.75, down 23 cents from last Wednesday.
 Matt Gunn-KTVO/KHQA 
 IOWA, ILLINOIS & MISSOURI— Tri-State drivers continue to see some relief at the pump.
 The national average for a gallon of regular unleaded is now $3.75 , down 23 cents from last Wednesday.
 The average price for a gallon of diesel is $5.57, down 25 cents from last week.
 On average, a gallon of gas will cost you $3.56 in Iowa.
 Gas is $3.45 a gallon in Missouri.
 In Illinois, the average price for a gallon of gas is $4.06.
 In Adair County, Mo., the price at the pump is $3.57.
 In Adams County, Ill., it is $4.06.
 Regular unleaded in Wapello County, Iowa, is $3.61 a gallon.
